 Big 12 Football Schedule Adjustments for Saturday, November 14
 Story Links
 Big 12 Football Composite Schedule 
 IRVING, Texas – The Big 12 Conference has announced its slate of football games on Saturday, Nov. 14 has adjusted kickoff times due to Friday’s national FAA ground stop on all air travel.
The Kansas-West Virginia game will now kickoff at 3:30 p.m. ET (2:30 p.m. CT) on ESPN2, and the Arizona State-UCF game will begin at 5:30 p.m. ET (3:30 p.m. MT) on ESPNU.
The Baylor-BYU game in Provo will now kickoff at 6:00 p.m. CT (5:00 p.m. MT) on FOX, and the game between Utah and Arizona will begin at 9:30 p.m. CT (8:30 p.m. MT) in Tucson on FOX.
Additionally, Saturday's Cincinnati-Iowa State game in Ames will remain at 11 a.m. CT on TNT and HBO Max. The Texas Tech-Oklahoma State match-up in Stillwater will stay at 8:30 p.m. CT on ESPN. The Kansas State-TCU game in Fort Worth, Texas will also be played as scheduled at 1 p.m. CT on ESPNU.
